meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Basic Statistical Return 2 (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: BSR-2 stocks are final on release for the year; the sector classification changed in 2018-19 and the deposit-size bands in March 2026 (both disclosed, never spliced).
meta.coverage: Deposits by owning sector and bank group, as on 31 March. Amounts in ₹ crore; accounts, offices and employees as counts.
meta.note: RBI BSR-2 Table 1.5 via DBIE report 850, read from the Data Bank mirror. Column meanings are fixed by identities checked on every row (scripts/lib/products/bsr2-tables.mjs). Tables 1.x include deposits of banks with other banks; tables 2.x and 3.x leave them out.
